name: v1.106.4
body:
## Verify this release

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.106.4
```

Same command for `litellm-database`, `litellm-non_root` and the `docker.io/litellm/*` images

## What's new in 1.106.4

3 PRs. 2 fixed. No action needed to upgrade

### Changes

- **Deployment:** Fixed the proxy sometimes exiting on startup with an `ImportError` when it cannot reach the remote model cost map, broken since v1.104.0 (#46711) <sup>Also in [1.104.7](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.104.7), [1.105.5](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.105.5)</sup>
- **Deployment:** Fixed image scans flagging brotli 1.2.0, the emSign ECC Root CA - G3 and unused lockfile packages (#48283, #48300)

---

Backport #48294 · [Full changelog](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/compare/v1.106.3...v1.106.4)
